container.title: DSH Chat
description: Continue-style chat UI for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) inside VS Code. Runs `dsh web` in the background and renders the conversation natively in VS Code (bilingual UI).

config.command:
Command used to start the server, run exactly as written (the extension appends nothing). Defaults to `dsh web --port 0 --no-open`: `--port 0` lets the OS pick a free port, `--no-open` keeps the system browser out of the way. Write your own flags here when you want something else, e.g. `dsh web --port 3080 --no-open`. Note that `dsh web` is only the alias of the built-in `web` profile — for a custom profile write `dsh --profile <name> --port 0 --no-open`.

**Reload the window for this change to take effect.**
config.url:
Base URL of an already running `dsh web` server (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:3080`). **Once set it takes over completely**: `dshChat.command` and `dshChat.autoStart` stop applying and the extension connects straight to this address.

**Reload the window for this change to take effect.**
config.autoStart: Run the start command automatically when VS Code starts. Has no effect while `dshChat.url` is set.
config.openPanelOnStartup: Open the chat panel in the editor area when VS Code starts.
config.startTimeoutSec: How long to wait for the server to become ready, in seconds.
config.diffLayout: How edit tool calls render their change: single column or side-by-side.
config.diffLayout.auto: Adaptive: single column in a narrow panel, side-by-side when wide.
config.language: Language of the chat UI. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
config.fontSize: Font size of the chat UI in integer pixels (>= 8). `0` follows the VS Code font size.
config.questionBatch: How many questions of one questionnaire to show at once. A questionnaire with more questions than this is asked one question at a time. `0` always shows every question at once.
